headline: Revenue climbs, losses narrow as remeasurement charges ease
summary_short: BEPC's Q2 2026 revenue rose to $1,076M, up 13.0% y/y and 21.9% q/q, while the net loss narrowed to $785M from $1,447M a year ago and $2,186M last quarter, mainly on smaller non-cash remeasurement charges tied to BEPC's exchangeable shares.
summary_long: Revenue grew 13.0% y/y and 21.9% q/q to $1,076M on higher realized pricing, strong European solar generation and favorable FX, partly offset by recently completed asset sales and weak U.S./Colombia hydrology. Direct operating costs rose faster (+28.3% y/y) on higher Colombian power-purchase pass-throughs, but operating income still grew 9.1% y/y to $277M on lower depreciation. The $785M net loss (vs $1,447M a year ago) is almost entirely non-cash IFRS remeasurement of BEPC's exchangeable/class A.2 shares and the partnership's interest in BRHC, which shrank alongside a smaller unit-price increase than a year ago. Available liquidity rose to $5,127M. The board raised the quarterly distribution to $0.392/unit, targeting 5%-9% annual distribution growth. No new company guidance appears in this filing.
